login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to see your orders and tickets.
login.linkHint: No password needed – we will send you a link that signs you in.

twoFactor.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
twoFactor.hint: A recovery code can only be used once.

errors.LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.EXPIRED: The sign-in expired. Please enter your password again.
errors.INVALID: The e-mail address or password is not correct.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: With an account you can see all your orders and download your tickets again at any time.
register.guestNote: Bought tickets as a guest before? Register with the same e-mail address – once it is confirmed, your earlier orders appear in your account.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your e-mail address and we will send you a link to set a new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account. You will be signed out on all other devices.

loginLink.title: Sign in
loginLink.description: Click the button to sign in to your account.

verify.title: Confirm e-mail address
verify.verified: Thank you – your e-mail address is confirmed. Your orders are now shown in your account.
verify.alreadyVerified: Your e-mail address has already been confirmed.
verify.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Sign in and request a new link in your account.
verify.verifiedNoPassword: Your e-mail address is confirmed. As a precaution, a password set before the confirmation was removed – please sign in with an e-mail link or choose "Forgot your password?" to set a new one.

overview.title: My account
overview.passwordReset: Your new password has been saved. You have been signed out on all other devices.
overview.unverified: We have sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your orders appear here as soon as the address is confirmed.
overview.noPassword: You signed in with an e-mail link. Set a password below if you also want to sign in with it.

orders.title: My orders
orders.unverified: Confirm your e-mail address to see your orders.

profile.title: Personal details
profile.description: Used to pre-fill the checkout. Changes do not affect existing orders.
profile.emailHint: The e-mail address cannot be changed.
profile.countryHint: Two-letter code, e.g. DE, AT, CH

password.title: Password
password.changeDescription: After the change you will be signed out on all other devices.
password.setDescription: Set a password to sign in without an e-mail link.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The e-mail address or password is not correct.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} or sign in with an e-mail link.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.ACCOUNTS_DISABLED: Customer accounts are currently not available.
errors.LOGIN_LINK_DISABLED: Sign-in via e-mail link is currently not available.
errors.CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID: The current password is not correct.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.

fieldErrors.email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
fieldErrors.country: Please enter a two-letter country code (e.g. DE).
fieldErrors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.

messages.registered: Almost done! We have sent an e-mail to {email}. Please confirm your address with the link it contains, then sign in. If you already have an account, the e-mail contains a sign-in link instead.
messages.linkSent: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent it a sign-in link. The link is valid for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
messages.resetSent: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent it a link to set a new password. The link is valid for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
messages.verificationSent: We have sent a new confirmation link to {email}.
messages.alreadyVerified: Your e-mail address has already been confirmed.
